large_guidance: The heavy op in this model is the `nn.Linear` (specifically `Conv1D` in HuggingFace GPT-2, which is a Linear) inside each transformer block's attention (`c_attn`, `c_proj`) and MLP (`c_fc`, `c_proj`), plus the final `lm_head` Linear projecting hidden states to vocab logits. The previous attempt only replaced GELU (a cheap pointwise op) and left every Linear running in PyTorch — that is why `heavy_op_executed_in_pytorch=True` and the kernel was scored invalid. You must replace at least one of these Linear/Conv1D matmuls with a custom Triton GEMM kernel that executes unconditionally on the forward path. Concretely: (1) Write a tiled split-K GEMM Triton kernel using `tl.dot`, with `BLOCK_M=64/128`, `BLOCK_N=64/128`, `BLOCK_K=32/64`, grid `(cdiv(M, BLOCK_M), cdiv(N, BLOCK_N))`, accumulating in fp32 and storing in the input dtype. Handle the bias by adding it inside the epilogue (`acc += tl.load(bias_ptr + offs_n, mask=offs_n<N)`). Mask M and N edges with `offs_m[:,None]<M` and `offs_n[None,:]<N`. Make sure the kernel performs the full M*N*K multiply-add count — no pre-reducing the weight or input along any axis. (2) Subclass `transformers.pytorch_utils.Conv1D` (or write a wrapper module) whose `forward` reshapes the input `[B, T, C_in]` to `[B*T, C_in]`, calls the Triton GEMM against the stored `weight` (shape `[C_in, C_out]` for Conv1D — note this is already the non-transposed layout, so the kernel computes `out[m,n] = sum_k x[m,k] * w[k,n] + b[n]`), then reshapes back to `[B, T, C_out]`. Monkey-patch every `Conv1D` in `self.model.transformer.h[*].attn` and `.mlp` (i.e., `c_attn`, `c_proj`, `c_fc`) by replacing the module instance with your wrapper that holds the same `weight` and `bias` Parameters and calls the Triton kernel directly in `forward` with no `if self.training` / `if x.is_cuda` guard. Also replace `self.model.lm_head` (an `nn.Linear` with `weight` shape `[vocab, hidden]`, no bias) with a wrapper that calls the same Triton GEMM (passing `weight.t()` contiguous or handling the transpose via strides) — this single matmul is the largest in the model (32*256 x 768 x 50257). (3) Keep the existing TritonGELU replacement as-is for the MLP activation, but the GEMM replacement is what makes the submission valid and what will unlock real speedup. Verify correctness by comparing against `F.linear` / `Conv1D` outputs on a small tensor before integrating, and ensure your wrapper modules' `forward` is the only path — no fallback to `nn.Linear` / `Conv1D` anywhere.
